# Write a clear home inspection report in minutes

> Free home inspection report builder: pick findings from a library of plain-language comments, edit them, add notes and your own repair cost ranges, and print a clean report sorted by severity. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
